appliedenhancements.config.max_crafting_:
Choose the quantity input range: native AE2/addon input, up to Long.MAX_VALUE, or arbitrary precision. Submission continues through the host confirmation menu without selecting a planner. Exact amounts above long require a planner that supports them.
Default: Native AE2 (DISABLED)
appliedenhancements.config.enable_patter:
Cache pattern input validation and container-return lookups. Significantly improves large crafting calculations.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.pattern_cache:
Maximum multi-key cache entries retained per pattern. Limits memory use while preserving useful cache diversity.
Range: 8 ~ 256
Default: 32
appliedenhancements.config.enable_enhanc:
Enable enhanced material calculation in the crafting preview to show accurate missing, stored, and crafting item counts.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_storag:
Index candidate slots during AE2's existing external-inventory scan. Cached slots are revalidated; incomplete results fall back to AE2's full scan.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.enable_infini:
Allow unlimited extraction and planning supply for explicitly marked infinite cells. Only keys accepted by the mounted cell's extraction checks are supplied; finite cells are unchanged. Disable to preserve the original cell behavior and reported quantities.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_io_bus: Optimize Import and Export Bus Slot Routing

Reuse validated source and target slot hints for AE2 import and export buses. Incomplete operations fall back to AE2's original slot routing.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.enable_progre:
Show crafting calculation progress and the selected planner path.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_automa:
Enable automatic AELIS integration in AE2's native planner. Third-party API calls are not affected. Manual crafting-plan inventory reservations are active only while this is enabled.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.enable_chance:
Count extra (chance) outputs of marked processing patterns toward the requested total. Only patterns marked as chance-output patterns are affected. Requires the marker toggle on the processing encoding panel.
Default: false

When all crafts of a marked processing pattern are pushed and no output arrives for the idle time, push more crafts (sized by the pattern's learned yield, inputs taken from network storage) until the requested amount is reached. Requires the chance output bonus to be enabled.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.chance_top_up:
When a top-up wave lacks inputs that the network can craft (for example a dust ground from stock), start a normal crafting job for the missing amount; the next wave then finds the items in storage.
Default: true

Seconds without any output (after every craft was pushed) before a top-up wave starts.
Range: 1 ~ 3600
Default: 30

A job may add at most this many times its planned crafts of a pattern as top-up crafts.
Range: 1 ~ 1000
Default: 10
appliedenhancements.config.enable_aelis_:
Use exact BigInteger arithmetic for AELIS orders and intermediate demands above Long.MAX_VALUE. Long projections are for compatibility; CPUs decide execution and can read the exact execution API. When disabled, automatic AELIS uses legacy long arithmetic; explicit exact API requests remain exact.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_prefer_:
If AELIS cannot plan an item's first pattern but can plan a later one, use the later pattern. Without this, AELIS hands the whole request back to AE2's planner. Changes which pattern is used compared with AE2's order.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_chunk_r:
Let AELIS plan chains where a returned item (empty bucket, glass bottle) is used again in the same plan. Crafts run in chunks sized by the returned items in stock, so several machines can work in parallel. The CPU then takes up to that many returned items from storage and gives them back when the job ends.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_max_nod:
Maximum nodes analyzed by AELIS per attempt. Higher values allow more complex recipes but use more memory.
Range: 1000 ~ 1000000
Default: 100000
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_compile:
Compilation budget in milliseconds for each AELIS attempt. Limits time spent analyzing the crafting tree before execution.
Range: 100 ~ 30000
Default: 2000
appliedenhancements.config.aelis_diagnos:
Enable diagnostic logging only in integrations that read this compatibility setting. Applied Enhancements itself does not emit development or temporary planning traces.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.cycle_solver_:
Maximum material nodes in one strongly connected component (SCC).
Range: 4 ~ 1024
Default: 256

Maximum branch-search states for multi-candidate cyclic components.
Range: 1000 ~ 10000000
Default: 1000000

Maximum time in milliseconds spent by one global or local cyclic solve.
Range: 10 ~ 5000
Default: 1000
appliedenhancements.config.cycle_seed_po:
Select how cycle startup materials are handled after the proven cycle schedule finishes.
Preserve Minimum Seeds: keep the minimum seed vector for the next order.
Maximum Throughput: allow the current order to consume every cycle material.
Default: Preserve Minimum Seeds (PRESERVE_MINIMUM)
appliedenhancements.config.enable_aelis_:
Use the AELIS crafting-plan screen on this client. Disable to use AE2's original confirmation screen without changing planning or execution.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.section.cycle: Bounded solver for cyclic crafting dependencies.
appliedenhancements.config.section.perfo: Performance optimizations with validation and native fallbacks.
appliedenhancements.config.enable_provid:
Allow pattern providers to pull the outputs of their crafts back out of machines that keep them. Each provider face is configured in the provider's side panel (off by default). Only declared pattern outputs that are owed are pulled, never anything that is an input of the provider's patterns.
Default: false
appliedenhancements.config.provider_outp:
Forget owed outputs of a provider face after this many seconds without any output arriving (cancelled jobs, chance outputs that never come).
Range: 10 ~ 86400
Default: 300
appliedenhancements.config.section.compa: Workarounds for bugs in other mods.
appliedenhancements.config.fix_matrix_cr:
ExtendedAE Assembler Matrix: count down the crafters' output hand-over cooldown. Without this, one partial hand-over (for example full storage) stops that crafter from ever delivering outputs again until the world is reloaded, so crafting jobs hang.
Default: true
appliedenhancements.config.section.diagn: Optional debug logging, off by default.
appliedenhancements.config.enable_diagno:
Write [ACE/diag] debug lines to the log (crafting CPU stalls and refusals, ExtendedAE Assembler Matrix state, pattern pushes). Costs some performance and log space: only switch on while debugging.
Default: false
